source: Original fictional classroom and public-space grammar situations; no third-party material

items.prompt: A teacher wants learners to read the sign. Which request is correct?

choices.text: 看板を読んでください。
choices.rationale: Correct. 読んでください requests that the listener read the sign.

choices.text: 看板を読んでもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Review. The permission question asks about the speaker's action; the prohibition bans reading. 読んでください requests that the listener read the sign.

choices.text: 看板を読んではいけません。
choices.rationale: Review. The permission question asks about the speaker's action; the prohibition bans reading. 読んでください requests that the listener read the sign.

items.explanation: 読んでください requests that the listener read the sign.
items.feedback: 読んでください requests that the listener read the sign.

items.prompt: You want to use the classroom dictionary. What do you ask?

choices.text: 辞書を使ってください。
choices.rationale: Review. ください requests someone else to use it; はいけません forbids it. 使ってもいいですか asks whether the speaker may use the dictionary.

choices.text: 辞書を使ってもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Correct. 使ってもいいですか asks whether the speaker may use the dictionary.

choices.text: 辞書を使ってはいけません。
choices.rationale: Review. ください requests someone else to use it; はいけません forbids it. 使ってもいいですか asks whether the speaker may use the dictionary.

items.explanation: 使ってもいいですか asks whether the speaker may use the dictionary.
items.feedback: 使ってもいいですか asks whether the speaker may use the dictionary.

items.prompt: A sign bans photographs. Which sentence states the rule?

choices.text: 写真を撮ってください。
choices.rationale: Review. ください is a request; もいいですか asks permission. 撮ってはいけません prohibits taking photographs.

choices.text: 写真を撮ってもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Review. ください is a request; もいいですか asks permission. 撮ってはいけません prohibits taking photographs.

choices.text: 写真を撮ってはいけません。
choices.rationale: Correct. 撮ってはいけません prohibits taking photographs.

items.explanation: 撮ってはいけません prohibits taking photographs.
items.feedback: 撮ってはいけません prohibits taking photographs.

items.prompt: Which is the て-form of 書く used in a polite request?

choices.text: 書いて
choices.rationale: Correct. 書く becomes 書いて before ください.

choices.text: 書って
choices.rationale: Review. 書って and 書きて are not the correct て-form of 書く. 書く becomes 書いて before ください.

choices.text: 書きて
choices.rationale: Review. 書って and 書きて are not the correct て-form of 書く. 書く becomes 書いて before ください.

items.explanation: 書く becomes 書いて before ください.
items.feedback: 書く becomes 書いて before ください.

items.prompt: Complete: ここに座っ＿＿いいですか。 (May I sit here?)

choices.text: ては
choices.rationale: Review. ては needs a prohibition ending; て alone does not form this permission question. 座ってもいいですか asks permission to sit.

choices.text: ても
choices.rationale: Correct. 座ってもいいですか asks permission to sit.

choices.text: て
choices.rationale: Review. ては needs a prohibition ending; て alone does not form this permission question. 座ってもいいですか asks permission to sit.

items.explanation: 座ってもいいですか asks permission to sit.
items.feedback: 座ってもいいですか asks permission to sit.

items.prompt: Which Japanese sentence means 'Please wait here'?

choices.text: ここで待ってはいけません。
choices.rationale: Review. The other choices prohibit waiting or ask permission to wait. 待ってください asks the listener to wait.

choices.text: ここで待ってもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Review. The other choices prohibit waiting or ask permission to wait. 待ってください asks the listener to wait.

choices.text: ここで待ってください。
choices.rationale: Correct. 待ってください asks the listener to wait.

items.explanation: 待ってください asks the listener to wait.
items.feedback: 待ってください asks the listener to wait.

items.prompt: Which is a polite affirmative reply to 入ってもいいですか。?

choices.text: はい、いいですよ。
choices.rationale: Correct. はい、いいですよ grants permission in this friendly context.

choices.text: いいえ、入ってください。
choices.rationale: Review. The other replies do not simply affirm permission. はい、いいですよ grants permission in this friendly context.

choices.text: 入ってはいけませんか。
choices.rationale: Review. The other replies do not simply affirm permission. はい、いいですよ grants permission in this friendly context.

items.explanation: はい、いいですよ grants permission in this friendly context.
items.feedback: はい、いいですよ grants permission in this friendly context.

items.prompt: Which sentence prohibits eating in this room?

choices.text: この部屋で食べてください。
choices.rationale: Review. ください requests eating; もいいですか asks permission. 食べてはいけません is a prohibition; で marks the place of eating.

choices.text: この部屋で食べてはいけません。
choices.rationale: Correct. 食べてはいけません is a prohibition; で marks the place of eating.

choices.text: この部屋で食べてもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Review. ください requests eating; もいいですか asks permission. 食べてはいけません is a prohibition; で marks the place of eating.

items.explanation: 食べてはいけません is a prohibition; で marks the place of eating.
items.feedback: 食べてはいけません is a prohibition; で marks the place of eating.

items.prompt: You need a classmate to show you the page. Choose the request.

choices.text: ページを見てもいいですか。
choices.rationale: Review. 見る means to look; 見せる means to show, so the other forms miss the intended action. 見せてください means 'Please show me' (from 見せる).

choices.text: ページを見てはいけません。
choices.rationale: Review. 見る means to look; 見せる means to show, so the other forms miss the intended action. 見せてください means 'Please show me' (from 見せる).

choices.text: ページを見せてください。
choices.rationale: Correct. 見せてください means 'Please show me' (from 見せる).

items.explanation: 見せてください means 'Please show me' (from 見せる).
items.feedback: 見せてください means 'Please show me' (from 見せる).

items.prompt: Which verb form correctly starts 'Please drink water'?

choices.text: 水を飲んで
choices.rationale: Correct. 飲む becomes 飲んで, giving 水を飲んでください。

choices.text: 水を飲みて
choices.rationale: Review. 飲みて and 飲って are not standard て-forms. 飲む becomes 飲んで, giving 水を飲んでください。

choices.text: 水を飲って
choices.rationale: Review. 飲みて and 飲って are not standard て-forms. 飲む becomes 飲んで, giving 水を飲んでください。

items.explanation: 飲む becomes 飲んで, giving 水を飲んでください。
items.feedback: 飲む becomes 飲んで, giving 水を飲んでください。

items.prompt: Which pair has the same verb but changes request into permission question?

choices.text: 書いてください／読んでもいいですか
choices.rationale: Review. The first changes verbs; the third changes the request to a prohibition. Both use 書いて; ください requests writing, while もいいですか asks permission to write.

choices.text: 書いてください／書いてもいいですか
choices.rationale: Correct. Both use 書いて; ください requests writing, while もいいですか asks permission to write.

choices.text: 書いてください／書いてはいけません
choices.rationale: Review. The first changes verbs; the third changes the request to a prohibition. Both use 書いて; ください requests writing, while もいいですか asks permission to write.

items.explanation: Both use 書いて; ください requests writing, while もいいですか asks permission to write.
items.feedback: Both use 書いて; ください requests writing, while もいいですか asks permission to write.

items.prompt: A library sign says ここで話してはいけません. What does it mean?

choices.text: Please talk here.
choices.rationale: Review. The request and permission readings require different endings. 話してはいけません says talking here is prohibited.

choices.text: May I talk here?
choices.rationale: Review. The request and permission readings require different endings. 話してはいけません says talking here is prohibited.

choices.text: You must not talk here.
choices.rationale: Correct. 話してはいけません says talking here is prohibited.

items.explanation: 話してはいけません says talking here is prohibited.
items.feedback: 話してはいけません says talking here is prohibited.
